title: Living or Leaving: Life in the Mekong Delta Region of Viet Nam
temporal_coverage: Report published 2025; the Life in the Mekong Survey covered 5,000 households across 13 delta provinces in April–June 2024; poverty simulations extend to 2050.
methodology: 2024 household survey, official statistics and climate-shock simulations.

title: Report on Children’s Perspectives on Climate Change, Environmental Protection and Socio-Economic Development
organization: UNICEF Viet Nam and Viet Nam Ministry of Planning and Investment
temporal_coverage: Published July 2025; student survey and consultations concern climate perceptions and policies in three Mekong Delta provinces.
methodology: Questionnaire survey of 756 students in six schools, plus focus groups and institutional consultations in three provinces.
limitations: Self-reported school sample; findings do not estimate province-wide prevalence.

title: Insights from Viet Nam: Delivering child-responsive rapid response and resilience-building interventions informed by the principles of Accountability to Affected Populations
organization: UNICEF Innocenti – Global Office of Research and Foresight
temporal_coverage: Case study covers UNICEF response to Typhoon Yagi from September 2024 through June 2025; published December 2025.
methodology: UNICEF case study reports response activities and draws on the government-led multi-sector damage assessment.
limitations: Agency case study; not a counterfactual evaluation of impacts or outcomes.

title: Viet Nam: Typhoon Yagi and Floods Joint Response Plan, September 2024–June 2025
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs on behalf of the UN Country Team and partners
temporal_coverage: Joint response plan issued 27 September 2024 for typhoon and flood response and early recovery through June 2025.
methodology: OCHA-consolidated interagency plan uses government disaster data and sector assessments to set needs, targets and response priorities.
limitations: Planning estimates and commitments, not an outcome evaluation; event-specific and dated.
